ai.text: This bill renews the authority of the National Emergency Medical Services Memorial Foundation to build a monument in Washington, DC, honoring the dedication and service of emergency medical workers. That permission ends seven years after the bill becomes law.

summary.label: Congressional Research Service, Reported to House
summary.text:
National Emergency Medical Services Memorial Extension Act
This bill reauthorizes the National Emergency Medical Services Memorial Foundation to establish in Washington, DC, a monument to commemorate the commitment and service represented by emergency medical services. This authorization expires seven years after enactment of the bill.
